claims: The McDonald's Saja Boys Breakfast Meal is a limited-time offering.
The McDonald's Saja Boys Breakfast Meal is inspired by the Netflix film KPop Demon Hunters.
The McDonald's Saja Boys Breakfast Meal launches March 31, 2026.
The McDonald's Saja Boys Breakfast Meal features a Spicy Sausage McMuffin with Egg topped with peppery Spicy Saja Sauce.
The McDonald's Saja Boys Breakfast Meal features hash browns.
The McDonald's Saja Boys Breakfast Meal features a small soft drink.
Each McDonald's Saja Boys Breakfast Meal includes 1 of 8 collectible photocard packs featuring Jinu and the Saja Boys.
Each McDonald's Saja Boys Breakfast Meal includes a "Derpy" access card.
The "Derpy" access card contains a QR code.
The QR code unlocks exclusive app content.
The Spicy Saja McMuffin is a standard Sausage McMuffin with Egg featuring a new peppery Spicy Saja Sauce.
The McDonald's Saja Boys Breakfast Meal has approximately 800 calories.
The McDonald's Saja Boys Breakfast Meal is available for a limited time at participating McDonald's.
The McDonald's Saja Boys Breakfast Meal is available via the app for pickup.
The McDonald's Saja Boys Breakfast Meal is available via McDelivery.
The McDonald's Saja Boys Breakfast Meal is released alongside a competing "HUNTR/X Meal".
The McDonald's Saja Boys Breakfast Meal is released alongside the "Derpy McFlurry".
The McDonald's Saja Boys Breakfast Meal is released as part of a KPop Demon Hunters collaboration.
